privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Electra International collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacy.html:
1. Information We Collect

We may collect personal and non-personal information when you visit our website, create an account, place an order, or contact us.

  • Name, email address, and phone number
  • Billing and shipping address
  • Payment information and order details
  • IP address, browser type, device information, cookies, and usage data

2. How We Use Your Information

Electra International uses collected information to process orders, provide customer support, improve services, send important notifications, prevent fraud, and personalize your experience.

3. Data Protection and Security

We use appropriate security measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or loss. Sensitive information is processed through secure systems and encrypted channels.

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data only with trusted service providers, legal authorities when required, and business partners involved in order fulfillment.

5. Cookies Policy

Cookies are used to enhance user experience, remember preferences, and track website performance. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not work as expected.

6. Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, subject to legal and operational requirements.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: The terms that govern your use of Electra International services and purchases.
terms.html:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using Electra International, you agree to comply with these terms and all applicable laws and regulations.

2. Account Responsibilities

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.

3. Orders and Pricing

Product availability, pricing, promotions, and descriptions may change without prior notice. We reserve the right to cancel or limit any order at our discretion.

4. User Conduct

You agree not to misuse the website, interfere with its operation, or attempt unauthorized access to any systems or content.

5. Intellectual Property

All website content, logos, graphics, and branding remain the property of Electra International or its licensors and may not be copied without permission.

6. Limitation of Liability

Electra International is not responsible for indirect or consequential damages resulting from the use of the website or purchased products, except where prohibited by law.

7. Changes to Terms

We may revise these terms from time to time. Continued use of the website after updates means you accept the revised version.

warranty-policy.title: Warranty Policy
warranty-policy.description: Warranty coverage, claim process, and exclusions for Electra International products.
warranty-policy.html:
1. Warranty Coverage

Most products include a manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship for the specified period mentioned on the product page or invoice.

2. What Is Covered

  • Manufacturing defects
  • Faulty components under normal use
  • Authorized repair or replacement as per manufacturer policy

3. What Is Not Covered

  • Physical damage, misuse, or accidental damage
  • Unauthorized repairs or modifications
  • Damage caused by improper installation, power issues, or natural disasters

4. Warranty Claim Process

To make a warranty claim, contact customer support with your order details, invoice, product serial number, and a clear description of the issue.

5. Resolution

After inspection, the product may be repaired, replaced, or redirected to the authorized service center depending on the warranty terms and stock availability.

cancellation-refund.title: Cancellation & Refund
cancellation-refund.description: Rules for order cancellation, returns, and refunds at Electra International.
cancellation-refund.html:
1. Order Cancellation

You may request cancellation before the order is processed or shipped. Once an order has been dispatched or delivered, cancellation may not be possible.

2. Refund Eligibility

Refunds are processed only for eligible cancellations, approved returns, or valid cases confirmed by our support team.

3. Refund Method

Approved refunds are issued through the original payment method or another method approved by Electra International, after applicable deductions if any.

4. Processing Time

Refund timelines may vary depending on the payment channel, bank, or financial institution. We will notify you once the refund is initiated.

5. Non-Refundable Cases

  • Products damaged by misuse
  • Items returned without original packaging or accessories
  • Orders canceled after shipping in cases where cancellation is not permitted
